activityPrivacyHelp: Only results and error codes are recorded, not passwords.
addSMBHelp: Add smb://server/share to keep it connected.
alwaysProtectKeptShare: Shares kept connected are always protected
appSubtitle: Keep pinned SMB mounts connected · Clean up temporary mounts as needed
cleanupExplanation: The shield excludes a mount from temporary and daily cleanup. Manual Unmount remains available; mounts in use are never forced off.
cleanupScopeHelp: Manual and daily cleanup use the same scope. The system disk is never included.
confirmRemoveShare: Remove this share configuration and its saved password?
credentialsNeeded: Enter credentials in the share settings to reconnect after unmounting.
credentialsRequired: Non-guest shares require a username and password.
dailyCleanupTimeHelp: Uses the Mac’s current local time. Cleanup missed during sleep or while the app is closed will not run later in the morning.
duplicateSMBShare: This SMB share has already been added.
emptyProtectionList: No protected mounts. Add one from Current mounts in Overview.
eventDailyCleanupMissed: Daily scheduled cleanup: missed during sleep; skipped
favoriteSharesDescription: Check after launch, wake, or network recovery; reconnect pinned SMB mounts after unexpected disconnections.
importHelp: Only SMB mounts can be imported. Imported shares are protected from cleanup.
importNeedsCredential: Imported shares may need credentials before automatic reconnection.
invalidSMBAddress: Enter an address in the format smb://server/share.
keepRunningHelp: Automatic connection and daily cleanup require the app to stay open; the app will not wake your Mac.
launchAtLoginFailed: Failed to change launch at login: {error}
name: Name
newPasswordHint: New password (leave blank to keep the current one)
noCurrentMounts: No manageable external or network mounts are currently available.
noImportableSMB: No SMB mounts available to import.
noSharesDashboard: No pinned mounts yet. Click “Add share” to get started.
savedCredentialsHelp: Use SMB credentials already saved by macOS. MountMate will not store a password for this share.
settingsReadFailed: Cannot read settings. Back up {path} first; changes will not be written to disk.
shareAddressHelp: Enter only smb://server/share. Passwords are stored in the macOS Keychain. Shares kept connected are always protected from cleanup.
smbOnlyImport: Only SMB network mounts can be imported.
unmountMountHelp: Unmount this mount; pinned SMB mounts will pause automatic reconnection
